roles.title: Paint the building!
roles.impact: You'll be part of the new gym opening in Little Village, supporting community health and wellbeing.
roles.description:
Calling ☎️ all volunteers.
This Saturday is our PAINTING PARTY!
9 am Free Community workout.
10 am at the Mack Garage - followed by the NEW garage.

Huge thanks to @thecolorblocdetroit & @lionsandrabbits @bananasnhannahs for getting us all set up for the big day.

Come lend a hand or help pass out water & snacks and direct the crew. Or just come hang and keep us on task.

Thank you for the endless support as we navigate this big move and transition.
Love, Terra, River & the whole Detroit Body Garage crew

roles.title: Park cleaning group
roles.impact: A clean park brings families back outside. You'll help keep Little Village's green space safe and welcoming for everyone on the block.
roles.description:
Neighbors, it's cleanup day at the park!
We'll split into crews for litter pickup, weeding and prepping the playground for fall.

Gloves, bags and grabbers provided - just bring water and comfortable shoes. Kids are welcome with an adult, and there's coffee and donuts for early birds at 9:45.

Every bag we fill keeps the park a place families want to be. See you out there!

roles.title: Adoption awareness event
roles.impact: Every adoption opens a spot for another street cat. You'll help Corktown's colony cats find homes and neighbors find company.
roles.description:
Meow Market is back!
Our adoption awareness pop-up returns to Corktown, and the colony cats need friendly faces at the table.

You'll greet visitors, share adoption info, and help our photographers get the cats their best glamour shots. First time? We'll pair you with an experienced volunteer.

Every conversation helps a street cat find a warm home before winter.

roles.title: Gardening with wildflowers
roles.impact: Wildflowers bring pollinators and color back to the neighborhood. You'll help Kintsugi Village grow a corner of Corktown everyone can enjoy.
roles._note: full on purpose: shows the waitlist label and the full-role penalty in scoring
roles.description:
Wildflower planting day at the village garden!
We're seeding the new pollinator beds along the fence and mulching the paths before the fall rain.

No green thumb needed - we'll show you everything. Tools, gloves and seeds are ready; wear clothes that can get dirty.

Stay after for lemonade and a walk through what last spring's volunteers planted.

roles.title: Wall prep day
roles._note: baseFilled 1 + three logged sample volunteers = 4 of 4
roles.description:
Before the paint comes the prep.
We're washing walls, scraping loose patches and taping edges so Friday's painting party can fly.

Bring work gloves if you have them; everything else is on us. Pizza for the crew when we wrap.

roles.title: Opening day greeters
roles.impact: First impressions decide who comes back. You'll welcome neighbors into the new gym and help opening day feel like a block party.
roles.description:
Opening day is almost here and we want every neighbor to feel it the moment they walk in.
Greeters welcome folks at the door, hand out schedules, and point people to the workout floor, the kids' corner and the snacks.

Short training the week before - you'll be ready. Bring your best smile.

roles.title: Board-up & block cleanup
roles.impact: Every secured house makes the block safer for the families still on it.
roles.description:
Crew day in Osborn!
We're boarding vacant houses, clearing two lots and hauling debris.

Tools, boards and lunch provided. A truck helps a ton if you have one.

roles.title: Tutoring night at the youth center
roles.impact: One steady evening a week changes how a kid feels about school.
roles.description:
Homework help and reading practice with our K-8 crew.
No teaching experience needed - we train you and pair you with the same kids each week.

roles.title: Welcome baskets for new moms
roles.impact: A warm welcome in the first weeks helps moms and babies get a healthy start.
roles.description:
We're assembling 60 welcome baskets - diapers, books, handwritten notes.
Bring your best encouraging words; we'll supply the rest.

roles.title: Harvest morning at the farm
roles.impact: Everything picked today goes home free with North End neighbors this weekend.
roles.description:
Harvest day! We're picking collards, tomatoes and squash, washing and boxing them for free distribution.
Dress for dirt; gloves and coffee on us.

roles.title: STEM Saturday demo crew
roles.impact: A kid who launches a bottle rocket on Saturday sees college differently on Monday.
roles.description:
Help run hands-on demo tables - bottle rockets, circuits, bridges - for 100+ Detroit kids and their families.
Student engineers lead each table; you keep the energy up and the line moving.

roles.title: Riverwalk greeter shift
roles.impact: Friendly faces keep the riverwalk feeling like it belongs to everyone.
roles.description:
Welcome visitors at Cullen Plaza, answer questions, hand out maps and point folks to the carousel.
Orientation 30 minutes before your shift.

roles.title: Fall planting on the Dequindre Cut
roles.impact: Ten thousand bulbs this fall become the riverfront's spring welcome.
roles.description:
Bulb planting along the greenway - daffodils and alliums by the thousand.
Tools, gloves and cider provided. Rain or shine.

roles.title: Saturday market setup crew
roles.impact: A smooth 6 am setup means 40,000 Detroiters shop local by 9.
roles.description:
Early birds only! We're placing vendor signs, setting barricades and directing trucks into Shed 2 and 3.
Coffee and a market breakfast on us when doors open.

roles.title: Trail day at Rouge Park
roles.impact: Cleared trails bring runners, riders and scout troops back to Detroit's biggest park.
roles.description:
We're rebuilding two footbridges and clearing brush on the stable loop.
Long pants and closed shoes required; tools and training provided.

roles.title: Community build day
roles.impact: Every board we salvage turns a blighted corner into a place neighbors are proud of.
roles.description:
Deconstruction and rebuild at the Artist Village block.
Experienced builders lead every crew - come learn or come teach.
